study.question: Observed: full auxiliary adapter-context transfer gives validation click AUC0.6670575100 versus blocked0.6668051957; tangent0.6669068957, radial0.6664308335, and radial-norm-matched0.6665097374 do not exceed full. Does retaining all nonopposing transfer while removing only the summed auxiliary component opposing the click context cotangent improve click AUC at unchanged capacity and justified measured cost? Gradient conflict has not yet been measured; the earlier embedding-relative projections do not diagnose it.
study.hypothesis: Full auxiliary context transfer may contain both helpful and locally opposing components. A click-referenced one-sided local VJP may preserve useful information discarded by embedding-relative radial/tangent projections while suppressing harmful transfer. This is a prospective, unverified mechanism. It predicts improvement over full transfer AND over direction-rotated and local-norm-matched controls; failure of those comparisons falsifies useful direction specificity for this implementation.

nearest_work.difference: Yu et al., Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning, NeurIPS2020, section2.3/algorithm1 read through public primary-source search on2026-11-07 after registry search did not supply the method. PCGrad projects conflicting task parameter gradients in pairwise task order. Here only the aggregate auxiliary adapter-context VJP is projected against an unchanged click VJP, locally before sparse accumulation. This is an adaptation of the projection principle, not a new principle or a PCGrad reproduction; no theorem or performance transfers.

study.proposed_difference: Insert one two-output identity at the shared context. The first output feeds BOTH click context consumers; the second feeds all three auxiliary adapters and their already-detached direct tower inputs. At summed-loss backward, let p and a be the respective cotangents reshaped [B,fields,embedding_dim]. For ||p||^2>1e-30 use a_projected=a-min(<a,p>,0)*p/||p||^2; otherwise retain a. Return p+a_projected to the shared context. Alternative controls select a projection relative to roll(p,d//2), or a scaled by the aligned-projection local norm. Arithmetic is FP32 with autocast disabled and result cast to context dtype; no double backward. Missing auxiliary or click branch returns the other unchanged. Full mode and eval bypass the operator. No new learned parameters, state, labels or forward information; module outputs and buffers must match at fixed state. No architecture novelty claim.
predictions: Above numerical guards, aligned projection leaves <a,p>>=0 unchanged and removes only the opposing component, producing <a_projected,p>>=0 and ||a_projected||<=||a|| locally within FP32 tolerance. These are algebraic checks, not evidence of better optimization or prediction.

If useful directional transfer exists in this implementation, context_conflict will exceed context_conflict_full_bridge, context_conflict_norm_matched and context_conflict_rotated on full validation click AUC, and exceed frozen g2 source0.6606469405 and g3 source0.6601633627 at measured cost.

All variants have the same learned capacity (expected32129765 total/336549 dense). At fixed weights all four probabilities and Dice buffers are numerically equal; eval executes the same inherited path. No inference throughput improvement is predicted.

Inspect all four task AUC/Logloss and fixed history-length slices with counts; earlier incumbent auxiliary AUCs(cart0.7786743/fav0.8031783/buy0.7561522) are substantially below DIN(0.8490697/0.8648975/0.8701823). A click gain cannot be described as improvement on every task.

If norm-matched attenuation or rotated-reference projection explains any improvement, reference-specific directional mechanism remains unsupported.

alternative_explanations: Earlier negative branches: g0-r0006-compressed_task0.6591942 failed to beat g2 source0.6606469; naive compression/task mixing was insufficient. Match-detail and ordered summaries later improved the local trajectory; no general complementarity theorem follows.

Opening auxiliary target+summary gradients in g0-r0032-adapter_items_both lowered click AUC to0.6661895. This motivates retaining existing item gates; it neither proves context conflict nor refutes auxiliary feedback usefulness.

Repeated full bridges reproduce one deterministic seed; radial/tangent failures can reflect loss of useful information, attenuation, stochastic split selection or optimizer dynamics rather than conflicting gradients.
Embedding norm geometry is not loss-gradient geometry. Even click-relative local alignment can be erased by repeated-ID accumulation, table aliases, BatchNorm coupling and adaptive preconditioning.
Attenuation, generic anisotropic regularization, changed accumulation order or validation selection can explain any apparent gain. Control comparisons reduce but do not eliminate these explanations.
The initial incumbent already sacrifices auxiliary-task quality relative to DIN. Continue to disclose this task tradeoff under click-only selection and the inherited offline visibility assumptions.
